db.execute("""
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    r.year AS year,
    CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) AS hours,
    substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1) AS rest
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN races AS r
    ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year < 1975
    AND res.positionOrder = 1
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
seconds AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    hours * 3600
      + CAST(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
      + CAST(substr(rest, instr(rest, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS total_seconds
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT
  year,
  AVG(total_seconds) AS average_time_seconds
FROM seconds
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;
""")

question: Which top 20 driver created the shortest lap time ever record in a Formula_1 race? Please give them full names.
final_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM lapTimes AS lt INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY MIN(lt.milliseconds) ASC, full_name ASC LIMIT 20;

question: Find and list the names of sets which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode WHERE T2.language = 'Korean' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM set_translations AS T3 WHERE T3.setCode = T1.code AND T3.language LIKE '%Japanese%') ORDER BY T1.name
